entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the most influential planeswalkers ever, a master of artifice with near-godlike power, curious and utterly callous, who planned years or centuries ahead.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Urza's millennia-long enemy tied to Phyrexia; he perished together with Urza.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Urza waged a vendetta against.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose history Urza was obsessed with as a young man.

entities.name: The Thran Empire
entities.description: The empire that once ruled Dominaria.

events.summary: Urza, obsessed with Dominaria's history and the Thran Empire, begins a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.
events.quote: This led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and the plane of Phyrexia.

events.summary: After countless years of conflict, Urza and Yawgmoth perish together.

relations.quote: This led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and the plane of Phyrexia.
